'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Syrian civil war]]
**[[Battle of al-Hasakah (2022)|Battle of al-Hasakah]]
***The [[Kurds in Syria|Kurdish]]-led [[Syrian Democratic Forces]] recapture a prison in [[al-Hasakah]] from [[Islamic State]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2022/1/26/kurdish-led-forces-in-syria-recapture-prison-from-isil (Al Jazeera)]
*[[2021–2022 Russo-Ukrainian crisis]]
**[[United States Secretary of State|U.S. Secretary of State]] [[Antony Blinken]] announces that the United States has given a written response to [[Russia]], aimed at the de-escalation of tensions between Ukraine and Russia. The response, coordinated with European allies and Ukraine, addresses Russia's demands and actions. [https://edition.cnn.com/2022/01/26/politics/us-russia-ukraine/index.html (CNN)]
*[[Mali War]]
**The [[Mali]]an junta demands that [[Denmark]] withdraw its [[Danish Defence|forces]] from the country, saying they were never given authorization to participate in the ongoing European-led [[peacekeeping]] operations. [https://www.msn.com/en-us/news/world/mali-tells-danish-troops-to-leave-european-special-force/ar-AATajUt (AP)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Europe]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Germany]]
****[[Germany]] reports a record 164,000 new [[COVID-19]] cases in the past 24 hours. [https://english.alarabiya.net/coronavirus/2022/01/26/German-COVID-19-cases-hit-record-as-parliament-debates-vaccine-mandate (Al-Arabiya)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Hungary]]
****[[Hungary]] reports a record 20,174 new COVID-19 cases in the past 24 hours, thereby bringing the nationwide total of confirmed cases to 1,471,276. [https://dailynewshungary.com/record-high-number-of-new-infections-in-hungary/ (Daily News Hungary)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Poland]]
****[[Poland]] reports a record 53,420 new COVID-19 cases in the past 24 hours, thereby bringing the nationwide total of confirmed cases to 4,637,776. [https://www.polskieradio.pl/395/7784/Artykul/2890880,Poland-reports-new-daily-record-of-53420-COVID19-cases (Polskie Radio)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Russia]]
****[[Russia]] reports a record for the sixth consecutive day of 74,692 new COVID-19 cases, thereby bringing the nationwide total of confirmed cases to 11.3 million. [https://www.themoscowtimes.com/2022/01/26/russia-marks-6th-consecutive-day-of-record-covid-cases-a76155 (''The Moscow Times'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Asia]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Israel]], [[COVID-19 vaccination in Israel]]
****[[Israel]]i [[Ministry of Health (Israel)|Health ministry]] approves the second round of [[booster dose]] of the [[COVID-19 vaccine]] for people aged above 18 years who have underlying medical conditions. [https://www.timesofisrael.com/health-ministry-approves-fourth-covid-vaccine-shots-for-at-risk-adults/ (''The Times of Israel'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in South Korea]]
****[[South Korea]] reports a record for the second consecutive day of 13,102 new COVID-19 cases, thereby bringing the nationwide total of confirmed cases to 762,983. [http://www.koreaherald.com/view.php?ud=20220126000209 (''The Korea Herald'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Brazil]]
***[[Brazil]] reports a record 224,567 new COVID-19 cases in the past 24 hours, thereby bringing the nationwide total of confirmed cases to 24.5 million. [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/brazil-reports-record-high-224567-cases-coronavirus-2022-01-26/ (Reuters)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Canada–Ukraine relations]]
**[[Prime Minister of Canada|Canadian Prime Minister]] [[Justin Trudeau]] announces the extension of [[Operation Unifier]] for three years. Sixty more [[Canadian Armed Forces|troops]] will also be deployed to [[Ukraine]] in the coming days. Trudeau's government also announces a shipment of non-lethal equipment and intelligence sharing. [https://www.ctvnews.ca/politics/canada-extends-military-operation-in-ukraine-for-three-years-1.5755493 (CTV News)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[LGBT rights in France]]
**The [[National Assembly (France)|National Assembly]] votes to criminalize [[conversion therapy]], with violators facing three years in prison and up to [[Euro|€]]45,000 in fines. The bill will now be sent to [[President of France|President]] [[Emmanuel Macron]] to be signed into law. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-60145970 (BBC News)]
